name: @realitycollective/native-environment
description: Native host adapter for the Reality Collective WebXR Environment Extensions - reads the environment, audio, sensing and scenes slices of globalThis.__rcHost that a native app (OpenXR, visionOS) installs, forwards the engine-free @realitycollective/webxr-environment core's ports to it as plain data, and ships the host conformance kit that proves a host on its device. No asset decoding here: a sky, an environment map, an audio cue or a scene crosses as a src string the native app resolves itself. Re-exports the core.
author: Reality Collective
